title: Define batched map and demap traits
description:
Add the batch-oriented mapper, hard demapper, and soft demapper interfaces that all modem backends must satisfy.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Public traits exist for batched modulation, hard demodulation, and soft demapping.
- [ ] The batch interfaces do not leak backend-specific details into the high-level API.
- [ ] The trait surface is sufficient for scalar, SIMD, and future GPU implementations.

## Notes

This task should build directly on the shared modem data model.
